title: REQ · Loader reports object and scene asset refs that are not manifest ids
summary: Dangling asset references are detected and named
description: Context: bedroom.yaml objects carry an asset string that must equal a manifest asset id, but only a test checks this today. Desired behavior: an exported loader helper takes the manifest and a list of refs and returns an issue for each ref that has no matching manifest id. Expected result: callers can validate content against the manifest at load time. Why: a typo in content must be reported, not crash rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given refs ['a','ghost'] and a manifest with only id 'a', when checkAssetRefs runs, then one issue is returned naming 'ghost'.
Given all refs match manifest ids, when checkAssetRefs runs, then an empty list is returned.
Given an empty refs list, when checkAssetRefs runs, then an empty list is returned and nothing throws.

out_of_scope: reading yaml scene files in the loader

definition_of_done: checkAssetRefs exported and covered by unit tests
